    inputLine = input()
    totalPairsCount = 0
    maxRun = 0

    while index < totalChars:
        currentRun = 0
        parenthesesPairs = 0
        position = 0
        while position < totalChars:
            c = inputLine[position]
            if c == '_':
                position += 1
                continue
            elif c == '(':
                position += 1
                while position < totalChars and inputLine[position] != ')':
                    if inputLine[position] != '_' and inputLine[position] != ')':
                        parenthesesPairs += 1
                        while position < totalChars and inputLine[position] != '_' and inputLine[position] != ')':
                            position += 1
                    else:
                        position += 1
            else:
                if c != '_' and c != '(' and c != ')':
                    currentRun = 0
                    while position < totalChars and inputLine[position] != '_' and inputLine[position] != '(' and inputLine[position] != ')':
                        currentRun += 1
                        position += 1
                    if currentRun > maxRun:
                        maxRun = currentRun
                    # position is already incremented in the loop
                else:
                    position += 1
        totalPairsCount += parenthesesPairs
        index += 1

    print(f"{maxRun} {totalPairsCount}")

main()
